label_revealing_columns: none: each file holds only 23 numeric timing features + label
session_information_reason: no IDs, IPs, ports, timestamps or capture-file names

parse.rule: Strip the trailing commas from every header line; skip data lines made only of commas.
parse.reason: The files were exported with stray commas that liac-arff can't read; the 60 s files of A1 and B have one comma-only line after @DATA, which is not a flow.

column_map.reason: A1 and B files hold the paper's Table 2 features (fiat/biat as min, max, mean, std) but 9 of their 12 headers shift those names by one pair; A2 files hold total_fiat/total_biat as named. Verified on every row (E00).

restore_flow_pkts.rule: A1 120 s only - replace flowPktsPerSecond with the value from B 120 s, row for row.
restore_flow_pkts.reason: In A1 120 s that column disagrees with A2 on 99.97% of paired rows; B 120 s is identical to A1 120 s in the other 22 columns of every row and matches A2 on 100%.

missing.rule: Count missing values; none expected, so nothing is imputed.
missing.reason: Imputation would invent values; the check proves none are needed.

infinite.reason: The flow tool writes rate 0 for zero-duration flows instead of dividing by zero.

fiat_not_measurable.reason: -1 means no forward gap exists (fewer than 2 forward packets); mean_fiat = 0 marks the same rows, so a flag column would repeat it. Never set to zero.

biat_not_measurable.reason: -1 means no backward gap exists (fewer than 2 backward packets).

flowiat_not_measurable.reason: Single-packet flows have no gap between packets.

active_idle_not_measurable.rule: Keep min/max_active and min/max_idle = -1 (with mean = 0) as-is.
active_idle_not_measurable.reason: The flow never had an idle period longer than the tool's activity threshold, so no active/idle period exists.

single_packet.reason: Real single-packet flows; dropping them would bias the data toward long flows.

negative_flowiat.rule: Keep negative min_flowiat values (other than the -1 code) as-is.
negative_flowiat.reason: Out-of-order capture timestamps (at most a few ms); a property of the capture, not a coding error to undo.

rounding.rule: Keep means, stds and rates of 1e7 or more as stored (3 significant figures).
rounding.reason: The source files already rounded them; the exact values can't be recovered.

packet_size.rule: Keep flows whose bytes per packet fall outside 40-1500 as-is.
packet_size.reason: Header-only packets (down to 30 B) and segments merged at capture (up to about 7 kB) are real traffic.

exact_duplicates.rule: Drop exact duplicates (all 23 features + label) within each file, keeping the first copy, before splitting.
exact_duplicates.reason: A copy in both train and test would score the model on rows it trained on.

conflicting_duplicates.rule: Keep rows with identical features but different labels (one per label after exact de-duplication); count them per class.
conflicting_duplicates.reason: They are real ambiguity in the data; removing them would make the test set easier than reality.

no_normalization.rule: No scaling or normalization at data level.
no_normalization.reason: Scaling is fitted inside each model pipeline on training folds only.

no_feature_selection.reason: The paper's feature set; feature groups are studied later in E09.

no_outlier_removal.reason: Long and bursty flows are real traffic patterns.

no_resampling.rule: No class balancing at data level.
no_resampling.reason: Resampling runs inside the pipeline on training folds only (E08).
